name: La Diva: lautten compagney BERLIN
description: baroque opera arias of Keiser, Vinci and Handel in the palace theatre
details:
Guest performance in the "Winter in Schwetzingen" series of Theater Heidelberg: soprano Johanna Kaldewei and the lautten compagney BERLIN under Wolfgang Katschner (theorbo) sing and play arias of the great female roles of baroque opera, from Keiser's Octavia, Vinci's Didone and Handel's Giulio Cesare.

Sunday 19:00 in the 18th-century Rokokotheater of Schwetzingen Palace. Price not shown; tickets in the theatre webshop or box office.
